chunks: But they turned their backs on him and went away.

key_terms.تَوَلَّوْا: They turned away / They faced away

ai.seo_question: What does the Quran mean by 'they turned their backs on him'?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, this phrase captures the psychological and spiritual obstinacy of those who, despite clear evidence, choose willful ignorance and turn their backs on divine guidance. It reflects the concept of *istidraj* or gradual alienation, where rejection becomes a habitual state of the heart, leading to ultimate spiritual loss.
